ai.title: Correct typecheck command in knowledge.md
ai.summary: Updated verification instructions in knowledge.md to use `bun run --cwd backend typecheck` instead of `bun run --cwd backend tsc`. This ensures developers run the correct script defined in package.json for type checking. Scope limited to internal documentation.

eli5.text: The documentation that explains how to check code for mistakes was updated so that the command developers run matches an approved shortcut name, instead of an older direct command. This only affects internal documentation used by developers and does not change how the software runs today. If you read the document, you'll see the suggested command now uses a shorter, predefined name rather than typing out the full tool name by hand.

ai.title: Deepseek timeout retries via withRetry
ai.summary: Deepseek API calls wrapped in `withRetry` with 90s timeout. `Promise.race` rejects slow requests, retrying only on timeout errors, not API errors. Mechanism in `backend/src/deepseek-api.ts`, docs in `backend/knowledge.md`.

eli5.text: When the assistant talks to Deepseek, it no longer hangs forever if the response is slow. Instead, if Deepseek takes longer than 90 seconds, the request is automatically retried up to 3 times before giving up. This only affects internal backend calls to Deepseek; regular users would not notice any difference. The change is live today.
